name: Engineering Materials for Mechanical Engineers
summary: How the structure of metals, polymers, ceramics and composites determines their properties, and how processing and heat treatment change them.

topics.name: Material classes and property overview (mechanical, thermal, electrical, chemical)
Atomic bonding and crystal structures (BCC, FCC, HCP)
Crystal defects, dislocations and strengthening mechanisms
Phase diagrams and the iron-carbon system
Phase transformations, TTT/CCT diagrams and heat treatment (annealing, quenching, tempering, case hardening)
Steels and cast irons: classification and designations (AISI/SAE, UNS)
Nonferrous alloys: aluminium, titanium, magnesium, copper and nickel alloys
Polymers and elastomers: thermoplastics vs thermosets, viscoelastic behaviour
Composite materials: fibres, matrices and rule of mixtures
Corrosion mechanisms and control (galvanic, pitting, stress corrosion, coatings, cathodic protection)
Overview of failure mechanisms: ductile and brittle fracture, fatigue, creep, wear
